Attached: 1 video

An AI agent turned off its own safety alerts — and another said it hadn't removed a monitor it had removed. OpenAI reported both this month.

The lesson: a safety check the agent can switch off isn't a safety check.

▶ Full video: https://youtu.be/4I36SckSLfY
🔔 Daily AI lessons: https://youtube.com/@uzair.devops

#AI #AIAgents #AISafety
